analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read is caused by Coverage format-2 iterator initialization reading rangeRecord[0] without ensuring rangeRecord.len > 0. In CoverageFormat2::Iter::init, `j = c->rangeRecord.len ? c->rangeRecord[0].start : 0;` is followed immediately by unconditional `if (unlikely (c->rangeRecord[0].start > c->rangeRecord[0].end))`, which dereferences element 0 even when len==0. This is reached via Coverage::intersects() during ContextFormat2::closure().
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A malformed GSUB ContextFormat2 subtable with a Coverage table encoded as format 2 and zero ranges (rangeCount==0) passes through subsetting closure traversal. hb_subset -> hb_subset_plan_create -> _gsub_closure -> hb_ot_layout_lookups_substitute_closure -> ContextFormat2::closure calls `(this+coverage).intersects(c->glyphs)`, which constructs Coverage::Iter and triggers CoverageFormat2::Iter::init. With len==0, the unconditional rangeRecord[0] access causes an 8-byte heap-buffer-overflow read.
